This year, we have amped up our partnership to secure even better benefits for TechBBQ participants, a huge pre-party, and side-events at Matrikel1 – Join us! Join the Pre-party Uniting the Ecosystem Situated in the heart of Copenhagen, Matrikel1 is the central hub for startups, investors, and ecosystem players like TechBBQ. Founded by Mesh Community in 2018, Matrikel1 benefits from being one of four Nordic hubs with: 250,000 yearly visitors 100,000 social media followers 5,000 members 1,700 yearly events Busses, passes, & benefits for TechBBQ participants For this year’s TechBBQ we will have buses to and from the TechBBQ venue, badge pick-up, and special deals for ticket-holders at Matrikel1 both days.
